component.name: DuckyDeck Studio
component.summary: KDE Plasma 6 Configurator & AI Macro Architect for duckyPad Pro

description.p: DuckyDeck Studio is a modern Qt 6 and KDE Kirigami desktop application for programming the duckyPad Pro (2024+) and original duckyPad (2020) mechanical macropads on Linux.

ul.li: Interactive 4x5 RGB mechanical switch matrix, rotary encoders, and 32 expansion channels
Live USB HID communication for profile switching, per-key RGB, RTC sync, and PGV (_GV0.._GV31) editing
Native KDE Plasma 6 Wayland active-window auto-switcher via KWin D-Bus scripting
AI Profile Architect grounded in local ~/.config/kglobalshortcutsrc KDE keybindings
